follow-up time: Current or subsequent week of gestation
study type: Cross-sectional analysis of administrative hospital discharge data
cohort: 166,559 singleton liveborn deliveries between 2007 and 2012 from 14 US member hospitals of the National Perinatal Information Center
finding: After controlling for confounding factors using propensity score methods, labor induction was associated with a decreased risk of cesarean delivery before 40 weeks of gestation but an increased risk at 40-42 weeks.
